name: Recital C
title: REPORT on the amendment of the European Electoral act, allowing Members to vote in plenary by proxy voting during pregnancy and after giving birth
part_text: whereas the reform of the European Parliament's electoral procedure should aim to enhance the democratic dimension of European elections, improve the functioning of the European Parliament and the governance of the Union, make the work of the European Parliament more legitimate and efficient, and provide for greater electoral equality for citizens of the Union;
